tldr: Venus through the 7th house softens partners, close friends, clients, conflict, and attraction.
body:
When Venus moves through your 7th house, it draws your attention toward partners, close friends, clients, conflict, attraction, and what other people bring out in you. You may notice more through direct encounters with other people: what feels mutual, what feels unfair, and what someone else is reflecting back.

You may notice what feels wanted, valuable, pleasurable, attractive, or worth protecting. It can help you see what you actually want to choose, keep, enjoy, or repair.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for seeing relationship patterns while they are active, not just after the fact.

The caution: Watch for choosing the pleasant answer because the honest one would ask more of you. The risk is making the other person the whole problem or the whole solution.

Venus moves through this house for a few weeks. Let ease show you what you value. Just do not confuse comfort with truth.
